tasks.label: Deploy: Git status check

tasks.label: Deploy: Checkout feature branch on VM
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'cd /opt/sicard && git fetch origin agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao && git checkout -B agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao origin/agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao && git status && ls -la'

tasks.label: Deploy: Verify branch on VM
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'cd /opt/sicard; git branch --show-current; ls Dockerfile docker-compose.vm.yml .deploy/update_vm.sh'

tasks.label: Deploy: Check git log on VM
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'cd /opt/sicard; git log --oneline -3; git branch -a'

tasks.label: Deploy: Force checkout feature branch
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'cd /opt/sicard && git checkout -B agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao origin/agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; git branch --show-current'

tasks.label: Deploy: Remove lock and checkout
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'rm -f /opt/sicard/.git/index.lock; cd /opt/sicard && git checkout -B agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao origin/agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao; git branch --show-current; ls Dockerfile docker-compose.vm.yml .deploy/update_vm.sh'

tasks.label: Deploy: Force checkout v2
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'cd /opt/sicard && git checkout --force -B agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao origin/agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao && git clean -fd && git branch --show-current && ls Dockerfile docker-compose.vm.yml .deploy/update_vm.sh'

tasks.label: Deploy: Verify branch v3
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'cd /opt/sicard && git branch --show-current && git log -1 --oneline && ls Dockerfile'

tasks.label: Deploy: Check git processes
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'ps aux | grep git; ls -la /opt/sicard/.git/index.lock 2>&1'

tasks.label: Deploy: Kill stuck git and clear lock
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'pkill -9 -f "git checkout"; pkill -9 -f git-lfs; sleep 1; rm -f /opt/sicard/.git/index.lock; echo done'

tasks.label: Deploy: Kill stuck PIDs
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'kill -9 1796747 1796754 1796775 1796776 1799951 1799952 1799953 1799954 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -f /opt/sicard/.git/index.lock; ps aux | grep -c git; echo done'

tasks.label: Deploy: Checkout skip LFS smudge
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PuTTY\plink.exe' -ssh ubuntu@56.125.163.194 -i 'SRV-SISTEMA-30001480.ppk' -hostkey 'SHA256:eaE7ZPAGxV4DfSDRZyi09s5LkeRgJcrA8qvMSCCxnf0' -batch 'cd /opt/sicard; export GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1; timeout 90 git checkout --force -B agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao origin/agent/consolidar-sicard-hierarquizacao; echo EXIT:$?; git branch --show-current'

tasks.label: Deploy: Verify files and docker
